# KHEM

> Luxury Egyptian fragrance and perfume house - Essence of Heritage.

KHEM is a luxury ecommerce brand rooted in Ancient Egyptian heritage,
offering fragrances, collections, and craftsmanship stories.

## Pages
- [Collections](https://khemperfumes.com/collections): Fragrance collections
- [Journal](https://khemperfumes.com/journal): Heritage and craftsmanship stories
